# Free roam: documented functions (`world`)

Reference table generated in the documentation round of 2026-10-31 and extended in the rounds of 2026-11-03 and 2026-11-04. Each row is a function that reached the `documented` stage (`docs/PROGRESS.md`): its prototype, purpose, return value, side effects and callers, read from the Ghidra decompilation with the names of that round. The same text is the function's plate comment in Ghidra (`re/documented*.tsv`, applied by `tools/ghidra/ApplySignatures.java`). How the subsystem works as a whole is in [`../world.md`](../world.md); pointers to structures are typed `void *` and the structure is named in the summary.

Functions: 2466 (BOOT.BIN 64, rel_blackjack 299, rel_connection 252, rel_cutin_viewer 1, rel_dodge 288, rel_field 298, rel_quiz 155, rel_reversi 120, rel_story 342, rel_throw 238, rel_throw_starter 12, rel_underground 397).

## `rel_story`

| Address | Prototype | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0x08e9aa00` | `int world_story_module_start(int arg)` | Module start of rel_story: when arg is 0 registers the story scene (system_scene_register(world_story_scene_main, world_story_scene_end_noop, 0x08ec9090)). Returns 0. Side effects: the scene registration. No direct caller (module entry point). |
| `0x08e9aa38` | `void world_story_scene_main(void)` | Entry of the story scene (scene 2): sets the thread attribute (sceKernelChangeCurrentThreadAttr(0, 0x4000)), runs world_init_story_globals, waits a frame and registers the scene frame/leave callbacks (system_scene_set_frame_callback(2, 0x08e9ac48, 0x08e9ac50)); when world_story_init returns non-zero it calls world_story_state_step once per frame (system_wait_frame) until world_is_story_scene_done returns non-zero. | `0x08e9f3ac` | `int world_story_init(void)` | Starts the story module. Binds the story-block sub-blocks to their owners (records +0x0000 and seen recipes +0x35b8, scene context +0x3250, event queue +0x3264, field state +0x32cc with sandwich bits +0x35b0, calendar +0x3438 / field save block +0x345c / flags +0x42d8, event state +0x3504, pick-up taken bits +0x3590, duel request +0x3528, block +0x3570, partner talk +0x357c, BGM state +0x3584), copies the partner word and loads and binds the script archives (returns 0 on failure). Unless the next scene mode is 3, fades out the BGM and requests the story sounds; sets 0x08ecd974 = 12 and the fade state 0. When bit 0 of the partner word is clear (new story) it resets all blocks, points and talk target and either starts a new game (system flag 0x1f clear: sets system flags 0x14 and 0x1f, location 2, calendar, partner row of (2, 0), 0x08ecd980 = 1, and with progress flag e9 bit 4 unlocks every row with a partner deck and at least 10 duels against it) or a restart (location 0xe, player position (arguments not recovered by the decompiler), calendar, character records); then state 4, save_set_partner_flag, scene return value 0, world_change_time(1, 0). Otherwise it forces the location set-up, world_change_time(1, 0) and dispatches on the next scene mode (world_get_next_scene_mode): 3 -> state 0x22; 4 (back from a duel) -> world_record_duel_result and the result records (see notes), state 0xb; 5/6/7/9/0xb (back from a mini-game) -> enters the location and queues (partner a1, 10, 1) + (301, 8, 1) when the score word exceeds 9999 (199 for mode 6), else (partner a1, 10, 2) + (301, 8, 2), state 0xb; 8 -> (301, 2, 2), system flag 0xc, state 0xb; 10 -> BGM 0xb, enters the location with every record flagged 4 (hidden), queues (301, 2, 0xd) and (partner a1, 3, 2), exit code 0x77, state 0xb; 0xc -> resets the duel set-up, state 0x25; 0xe -> state 1; other -> enters the location, state 5. Finally sets the next scene mode to 0. Returns 1. Side effects: all story globals, the story state 0x08ecd978, event queue, flags. Callers: 1 (world_story_scene_main). |

| `0x08e9fec8` | `void world_exit_story_scene(void)` | Leaves the story scene according to the next scene mode (world_get_next_scene_mode): 2 -> system_scene_call(2, 4, 5 when system flag 0x11 is set else 1); 3 -> scene_call(2, 4, 2); 4 and 0xc -> scene_call(2, 6, 0); 5, 6, 7, 9 and 0xb fill a BOOT parameter block (from BOOT 0x0885bd4c / 0x0885bd7c / 0x0885bd64 / 0x0885bdac / 0x0885bdc4) with the partner and variant, -1 words and for 6, 7 and 0xb the light period, then call scenes 0xf, 0x13, 0x11, 0x19 and 0x1c; 8 -> scene 0x18; 10 -> scene 0x15; each of modes 5-11 also sets one save progress flag (e8 bits 2, 4, 3, 6, 7, 5 and e9 bit 6).
